sources.evidence: Texture common incref/decref at25-66: only public0->1 pins device, public1->0 drops underlying draw texture reference before releasing device last; internal WineD3D storage holds preserve public-zero objects.
Windows-tested public references at1697-1725: SetTexture and unbind do not increase texture COM refs; GetSurfaceLevel increments shared texture/surface count without another device pin.
SetTexture maps to WineD3D internal stateblock texture holds; GetTexture explicitly AddRefs the public object. Public state-block object reference semantics remain outside this phase.

scope: Stage4J1: D3D9 public2D texture refs separated from sampler and texture-level target private holds. Zero public refs drop exactly one public device pin; GetTexture/GetRenderTarget/GetSurfaceLevel/GetContainer restore shared parent public refs and a pin only on0->1. Private sampler/target holds keep storage, cached surface wrappers, pixels and private data until final public/private release; reusable storage teardown unlinks and cleans before public parent release. Live binding replacement publishes new pointers before releasing old objects; recording/stateblock public holds retain existing semantics. Device clear/Reset uses private2D releases, DEFAULT Reset blockers count external shared public refs rather than discounting private slots. Native actual device/resource/set/query/reset/teardown functions use constructor/emitter stubs:86784 new checks,1024 pool/order profiles,8192 public-zero revivals, four sampler slots plus two target slots,13 strict runtime mutations and old actual methods plus new helper runtime negative control; ASAN/UBSAN. XP actual constructors/COM:two DEFAULT textures,three sampler bindings,128 texture/level revivals,public-zero sampled draw and public-zero RT clear,RT container/query shared count then sampling after target unbind,one refused and one successful Reset,three actual readbacks with simulated transport pixels. Independent GPU replay validates192 red/blue/green pixels and both explicit texture destructions after the Reset command and before post-Reset drawing with empty guest maps before genuine owner release. D3D8/cube/volume/buffer/shader/stateblock public binding refs, general external-child device-state retention, arbitrary callback reentrancy/concurrency, physical loss/full Reset/format/MSAA/fullscreen/multi-buffer/wrapper conversion, native HAL, games/FPS and overall stages4/5/6 remain open. Host/protocol/shader/bundle and D3D8/DDraw DLLs unchanged.
